prometeus.upside: The team is still shipping code (an agent-to-agent verification network pushed yesterday), so an AI-agent relaunch announcement could re-rate it; no date found.
prometeus.cheap: Old 2019 token that has rebranded several times; the market has stopped believing its pivots, and on-chain use (TVL under $1M) is tiny.
prometeus.wrongIf: No product launch or announcement explains the 10x volume spike by mid-December and the price gives the spike back.
prometeus.vsScanner: The spike is unexplained and PROM has had several similar pump-and-fade volume bursts this year; the scanner treats it as fresh interest, I treat it as noise.

ridges-ai.upside: Real product: a Bittensor subnet paying miners to build coding agents, with strong benchmark claims; a talked-about major exchange listing has never been confirmed.
ridges-ai.cheap: Subnet tokens across Bittensor have bled for a year and new tokens are emitted daily, so the market discounts every subnet, good or bad.
ridges-ai.wrongIf: Price makes a new low below $1.20 or daily trading falls back under $100K by early December.
ridges-ai.vsScanner: The score jump comes from a volume spike, not news; agree the project is alive, but nothing dated is coming.

umbra.upside: Working Solana privacy wallet (public since March 2026) and a vesting product with Streamflow; a centralized exchange listing would be the obvious next step, none announced.
umbra.cheap: Only trades on MetaDAO's own pool, so most buyers cannot reach it; it fell 53% this week.
umbra.wrongIf: Price breaks below $0.20 or no exchange listing or product news by end of December.
umbra.vsScanner: Spike came during a 53% weekly fall, which looks like selling, not discovery; scanner calls it a radar signal.

clearpool-2.upside: New CLEAR token after the CPOOL swap opened on 2026-11-17 (deadline 2027-02-17); more exchanges re-listing the new token over the coming weeks could add buyers.
clearpool-2.cheap: Market data is half-broken during the swap (CLEAR shows on MEXC only), so the token looks small and new; that is a data gap, not mispricing.
clearpool-2.wrongIf: Big exchanges have not switched to CLEAR by mid-December, or the price keeps sliding below $0.015.
clearpool-2.vsScanner: The scanner's 'ATH yesterday' is meaningless for a 4-day-old token, and supply rises from 1.125B to 1.428B over 3 years of unlocks.

pump-fun.upside: Pump.fun earns real fees and spends half of revenue on buybacks; a memecoin rebound would lift it first.
pump-fun.cheap: Team and early-investor unlocks are being sent to exchanges, staff were laid off, and only 43% of tokens are out, so sellers outweigh the buybacks.
pump-fun.wrongIf: Price stays under its November low and more team-linked unlocks hit exchanges in December.
pump-fun.vsScanner: Scanner rates it healthy on volume; I think the unlock overhang and 31% weekly fall matter more.
